checks.name: hover scenario sustains real physics, then actual STOVL forward conversion completes

details.method: Scenario HOVER spawn, 3 simulated seconds untouched hover, keyboard V, wait for physical fan/nozzle/door transition; read-only trace every 0.25 simulated seconds; no direct state teleport after spawn.

checks.qualityFailure: Configuration reached CONV while descending 31.78 m/s at 42.17 m AGL; safe sustained conversion was not established.

checks.name: actual runway acceleration and liftoff through keyboard inputs

details.method: Configured runway spawn; P releases brake, Shift commands full throttle, ArrowDown starts rotation at135IAS and releases by12°pitch or6mAGL; actual physics must reach12mAGL off wheels. No rigid-state assignment. This is takeoff only, not a full circuit.

checks.name: actual descent from configured hover to scored wheels-on touchdown

details.method: HOVER scenario start followed by actual descent. Every0.25simseconds a logged feedback test pilot taps the existing throttle slider. Desired descent ≤3m/s, slowing near ground; throttle = trim +(desiredVy-currentVy)*.035, bounded .3…1. No position/velocity/attitude/force assignment.

checks.qualityFailure: Scored contact was HARD, score 35; recorded sink and attitude exceed safe landing QA targets.

limitations: Cloud Chromium/SwiftShader functional tests; not Galaxy A51 evidence.
Normal UI start/scenario selection may position an aircraft at its configured spawn; tests label such starts. No lifecycle is inferred from teleporting aircraft state.
Replay stop is observed synchronously using a wrapper that calls the original function unchanged, before any later live physics step.
No Android installation, gyro, battery or thermal claim.
